{"relevant": true, "severity": "warn", "message": "Removing .env from the working tree doesn't remove the secrets from git history — if it was ever committed, DATABASE_URL and any other credentials are still recoverable from earlier commits. Rotate the database password (and any other keys in that file) via `fly secrets set`, and if history needs cleaning use git-filter-repo/BFG. Also, in internal/config/env.go, fail fast at startup if DATABASE_URL is empty, and make sure it's never logged (including in connection error messages). For Postgres on Fly, keep `sslmode=require` (or verify-full) in the URL unless using internal .flycast/.internal networking."}
